{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZhyR2Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhDIsZU", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 45, "title": "Correct CD drive report validity and retained-position transitions", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17.

At `2220cf841c6d9138e692f09f60da6d0f6031f668`, `CdBlock::report` constructs reports from media metadata and `self.fad` without applying the documented state-dependent validity rules. Seek Home sets STANDBY without recording its distinct position state. A subsequent seek-current/pause therefore reuses the previous FAD.

Existing tests partly encode this defect: `finite_retries_hold_fad_and_publish_only_after_the_configured_last_attempt` expects the failed FAD in an ERROR report. The standby test starts at FAD 150, so it cannot distinguish ordinary standby retention from Seek Home recovery. The original drive guest also expects an OPEN response derived from the inherited behavior.

These reports are part of normal CD driver control flow. Correcting them provides more useful compatibility progress than extending tests around already implemented transaction phases.

## Expected outcome

Implement the state-dependent report and retained-position contract for the currently supported drive states, including consistent Q-subcode queries.

Primary references:

- Sega [CD Communication Interface manual, later §7.2.5](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/prgg/sysg/cdif/hon/p07_11.htm): report validity table and retained values. OPEN, NODISC, ERROR and Seek Home expose invalid report fields; ordinary standby retains the paused report. Seek Home followed by PAUSE moves to FAD 150. Preserve retained repeat and recovery information independently of serialized invalid values.
- [ST-162-062094](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-162-062094.pdf), §4.2, printed pp.38–39; §7.2.4, pp.59–60; §7.2.5, p.61: corresponding drive/report and Q contracts. §4.3 permits Q acquisition regardless of drive status; reconcile the current blanket OPEN rejection with that provision.
- The later manual renumbers Q information to §7.2.4. Reconcile revisions explicitly. Do not invent exact values for undefined FATAL behavior or arbitrary BUSY transition phases.

Keep this increment focused on report generation, retained drive position and associated query behavior. Full mechanical timing, R–W decoding, additional media formats and HLE library completion remain separate umbrella work.

## Context and reproduction

Use original synthetic media and the existing register-test command helper:

1. Seek to a valid FAD other than 150 and await PAUSE.
2. Issue Seek Home, then query status.
3. Request pause using the unchanged-position encoding and await completion.
4. Compare every report field against the primary contract.

Current code reports the old position at home and resumes at that position. Separately, exhaust retries on an original damaged raw sector and inspect the ERROR report. Distinguish public invalid fields from retained internal recovery state.

The supplied snapshot has no open task Issues. Main CI is in progress, with no conclusion; this is neither failure nor passing evidence.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Document a primary-derived state/transition table before using implementation output as an oracle. Include exact references, applicable corrections and explicitly bounded timing conventions. Evidence-backed corrections to this AI-authored task must be documented in the source Issue without weakening validation.
- [ ] Implement report validity and position retention through actual command, error, standby and recovery paths. Invalid serialization must not overwrite internal position, repeat settings or recovery information. Preserve command-specific response payloads and the startup signature.
- [ ] Add independent native register vectors covering every supported state, both standby origins, noninitial positions, repeat retention, error recovery and Q queries. Use literal expected fields, not production report helpers. Correct inherited contradictory assertions with exact references while retaining their retry, sector-data and recovery checks.
- [ ] Check command and periodic response protection, CR4 release, SCDQ/HIRQ masking and acknowledgement before/equal/after relevant deadlines. Compare results across advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000 and passive debugger reads. Cover software reset, CD power control and cold boot without stale publication.
- [ ] Add or extend an original MIT-licensed SH-2 diagnostic and reproducible media builder. Guest instructions must issue commands, poll responses, transfer Q data and compute result records. Run identical bytes in native Machine execution and rebuilt production browser Wasm under `/saturn-rust/`, with changed position/media operands, an omitted-operation control and repeated cold boots.
- [ ] Demonstrate that independent native assertions and the executing guest detect the inherited report/home behavior. Hosts may load fixtures, advance execution and inspect results; they must not supply running guest records or substitute command results.
- [ ] Preserve Star Collector, Prism Courier, Hardware Lab, scheduled directory acquisition, selector transfers, ECC/retries, CD-DA, audio, backup, controllers and privacy regressions. Update the conformance matrix and validation record with actual results and remaining deviations.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native and Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, registered fixture/media reproduction checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, and the complete extended `npm run test:browser` without required skips.

This is partial #17 work. CPU/peripheral, multiprocessor/bus/reset, SCU/DSP, video/audio, remaining CD/media/HLE, SMPC and comprehensive integration requirements remain mandatory. Neither this task nor green CI establishes hardware completion or demonstrated commercial compatibility.

## Optional validation

None required. Personal firmware, commercial media, physical consoles, human approval, live Pages inspection and investigation of administrative tracker closure are not acceptance gates.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
